goals.label: Keeps the templates, with set weekly time and a rule for urgent jobs
Finds out why, then makes clear which jobs are the newer designers' and how Daniel helps them start
Counts the small jobs still coming in, with a target and who checks it how often

objectives.text: Daniel wants to push the templates to next year. Agree with him what happens to the templates.
The two newer designers send Daniel every tricky job. Agree with Daniel how to handle this.
Leadership wants to know whether the templates are working. Agree with Daniel how you'll both tell.
